pretreatments.description: Peracetic acid (PAA) pretreatment at concentrations of 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 mM/g VS. The feed sludge was pretreated with PAA by stirring the sludge with a magnetic stirrer at 450 rpm for 30 min at 25 °C after the addition of PAA. Glass containers with 5 L were used as anaerobic reactors, each reactor with a working volume of 2.7 L containing 1.8 L of seed sludge and 0.9 L of feed sludge (pretreated sludge). Each reactor was aerated N_2 gas for 20 min to provide an anaerobic environment, tightly sealed with a rubber stopper and incubated in a constant temperature water bath at 35 ± 1 °C.
